Hi Aditya,

We're starting planning for our Oct renewal and want to discuss a renewal that includes a staged capacity increase (add 200 GPU-hours/month in Q1, then evaluate for Q2) and a short-term price hold while we validate performance on the new workload.

Key asks from Cloudlytics:
- A 90-day price hold on current unit rates for the increased capacity while we ramp usage (we'll commit to a revised monthly minimum during that period).
- A clear mapping of credits/discounts if usage spikes beyond the staged band.
- Documentation we can share with procurement (MAAP and draft SOW).

Attaching our internal timeline and a procurement checklist (see attachment stub: Cloudlytics_Renewal_Timeline.xlsx - referenced).

Can we schedule a 30-min call early next week to map the mechanics? Procurement is targeting sign-off by Oct 10.

Hi Alice — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear asks. Monica and Ben are on this thread to help with pricing mechanics and capacity ops.

Quick proposal we can turn into a mutual action plan on the call:
1) Staged capacity exchange: Redwood will add an incremental 200 GPU-hours/month to your Dedicated pool effective on renewal-start. After 90 days we'll review utilization and convert to a permanent commit or revert the incremental portion.
2) Short-term price hold: We can hold current unit rates on the incremental capacity for 90 days from the renewal date provided Cloudlytics commits to a 3-month revised minimum spend (we'll list the figure on the call).
3) Upside protection: If usage on the incremental capacity exceeds the staged band by >40% in any month we'll apply an overage credit at 50% of the overage charges for that month as a one-time goodwill concession (to be agreed).
4) Attachments: I'm attaching the MAAP summary and a draft SOW for procurement reference (attachment stubs: Cloudlytics_MAAP_v2.pdf, Signed_SOW_draft.docx).

Operational notes:
- Monica: we'll need to reserve burst-capacity in the West region for their ramp window; can you confirm whether we can hold a soft quota?
- Ben: please prepare a short pricing exhibit showing the 90-day hold math and the post-hold baseline pricing.

Available slots for a 30-min call: Mon 9/21 10:00am PT or Tue 9/22 2:00pm PT. Which works for you?

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
